market_question: Abstract FDV above $200M one day after launch?
reasoning: Abstract is a live L2 from Igloo (Pudgy Penguins). L2 tokens typically launch with FDVs well above $200M (e.g., Arbitrum, Optimism, ZKsync). The token launch is highly likely before end 2027, and given the brand, even a modest token would exceed $200M FDV at T+1. Risk of no launch or catastrophic FDV is low.
evidence_points: Abstract mainnet launched Jan 2025; token speculation exists via XP programs and airdrop hints.
Comparable L2 token launches (OP, ARB, ZK) all had FDVs >$1B initially; $200M is a very low threshold.
Sister project PENGU token launched with >$2B FDV, demonstrating brand strength.
Only Base explicitly forgoes a token; Abstract likely needs one for ecosystem incentives.
sources_consulted: Crypto market data on L2 token launches
Knowledge of Pudgy Penguins / Igloo Inc.
